product.title: 2 Hour Sailing Cruise on Lake Tahoe

description.text: Sail Tahoe Blue on a small-group yacht limited to 18 passengers. This daily South Lake Tahoe sailing cruise includes complimentary local beer, wine, and non-alcoholic beverages while you glide across the lake under wind power.

highlights: Small-group sailing yacht limited to 18 passengers
Complimentary local beer, wine, and non-alcoholic beverages
Daily departures from South Lake Tahoe

start.description: Meet at the Sail Tahoe Blue check-in window next to Riva Grill, 900 Ski Run Blvd, South Lake Tahoe, CA 96150. Arrive 30 minutes before departure.

end.description: Return to the Sail Tahoe Blue meeting point at Riva Grill.
